title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Fee Computation: Late Payment Fee Amount
content:
**Computation clause.** The late payment fee of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program is figured for the billing month of the enrollment's most recently posted tuition charge. The fee is the base late fee, which is the program's late payment fee, rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

**Order of the 2026-27 schedule.** For a billing month of an enrollment of the 2026-27 school year, the amounts of the board-approved 2026-27 late payment fee schedule work together in one order:

1. the parts that set an amount from the base late fee and the month's tuition charge come first;
2. the parts that add a fixed amount are then added to that amount;
3. the fee is rounded once at the end, to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

For a billing month of any other school year, the fee is the program's late payment fee.

The program's late payment fee is the figure shown in the plan figures for due dates and late payment fees.

## Elements

| Element | Source |
|---|---|
| Month priced | the billing month of the enrollment's latest tuition charge, by posting date |
| Base late fee | the program's late payment fee |
| Rounding | once, at the end, to the cent, half a cent rounding up |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Take a hypothetical late payment fee of 12.00. The enrollment's tuition charges were posted for three billing months, and the latest by posting date is the third. The fee for that third month is 12.00. An enrollment with no tuition charge posted has no fee to compute.
